Hong Kong released its first five-year plan (2026-2030) and the 2026 Policy Address: AI as a key industry, reinforcing its role as the world's largest offshore RMB hub, supporting mainland and overseas leaders and emerging-industry firms to list in HK, an HKEX offshore RMB bond index plus reforms to connected transactions and spin-off rules, and a national power-semiconductor manufacturing innovation center by 2027. How much real incremental impact do these have on HK liquidity, IPO supply and HKEX itself? Which are structural positives and which are just framework language?

UK August CPI rose to 3.1% year-on-year from 2.9%, up 0.5% monthly, with output PPI at 3.7% versus 3.3% expected — yet core CPI held at 2.6% and services CPI at 3.4% came in slightly below forecast. After the release markets trimmed BoE hike bets, leaning toward four hikes by end-2027. Which data point is the market really weighting? Are sterling, gilts and the FTSE mispriced?

Zhipu told analysts it signed revenue-sharing deals with major domestic and overseas cloud providers, with revenue recognized from October; full-business ARR is already $1.8bn and year-end ARR guidance was raised 25% from $2.4bn to $3bn. The HK-listed shares jumped over 10%. How durable and profitable is monetizing open-source models via hosted APIs on overseas clouds? Is the guidance raise already in the price, and what might the market be missing?

The Clarity Act failed a procedural Senate vote (50-49, ten votes short of the 60 needed), stalling crypto regulation. Coinbase fell over 10%, Circle over 11%, and Bitcoin tumbled. Is regulatory uncertainty a short-term headwind or a structural problem? Kraken also reported Base and Cardano gateway outages the same day — how does this affect market confidence?

Japan's August exports rose 19.3% year on year, down from 23.2%, with shipments to the US up 24.9%, China up 20.6% and Asia up 21.4%, yet the unadjusted trade deficit widened to 1,105.6 billion yen and July core machinery orders fell 3.7% month on month, while Nikkei futures opened 0.3% higher. Analyze the divergence and what it means for Japanese equities and the yen.

Per The Information, ByteDance's H1 revenue rose 30% to $120B while profit fell to $20B on AI spending, alongside a merger of Doubao, Lark and Volcano Engine. What does this mean for China's AI supply chain?

The WTO projects AI will add 13.2% to global GDP and expand trade by 40% by 2040, with the biggest gains in digitally deliverable services. But with the 10-year Treasury above 5% and two Fed hikes expected, high-multiple tech faces discount-rate pressure. How do you weigh the long-term AI thesis against the near-term rate shock?

Apple has accepted Samsung's Q1 2027 memory pricing at roughly $2.0/Gb for DRAM and $0.33/Gb for NAND, 30–40% above Q3 2026 levels. Analyze the drivers of this memory upcycle (AI-server HBM crowding out commodity capacity), how many quarters it can last, whether phone and PC makers can pass costs through, and which parts of the A-share and Hong Kong memory, PCB and chip-equipment chains have earnings leverage that is underappreciated or already overpriced.

Bank of America's CEO guided Q3 trading revenue to be roughly flat; the stock fell as much as 6% intraday and closed down over 5%, its worst session since April 2025, dragging Wall Street banks lower. With the 10-year yield above 5% and a Fed hike expected, how should bank net interest margins and trading revenue be repriced?

South Korea's industry minister said the $200bn total investment cap and $20bn annual investment pace will be maintained as previously agreed with the US. SK Hynix meanwhile fell over 4% to $182.62 in grey-market trading. Analyze the real impact of this arrangement on the won, Korean fiscal capacity and the semiconductor supply chain, whether the market has fully priced the Korea-US deal, and the execution risks to watch.

The BRICS New Delhi declaration voiced serious concern over surging unilateral tariff and non-tariff measures that distort trade and breach WTO rules, while the Xi-Modi meeting stressed trade imbalances, supply-chain issues and predictable market access, with China taking the BRICS chair in 2027. How much does warmer China-India ties and the tariff narrative actually matter for emerging-market assets and country ETFs?

COMEX copper fell more than 1% intraday to $6.5157. Investors are debating a global copper shortage while puzzling over rising US inventories. Assess the real drivers behind the rally — inventory dislocation, tariffs and reshaped trade flows, or long-run electrification demand — and the key risks for bulls and bears at current levels.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed a three-step "pacing the frontier" strategy: slow the pace of capability improvement — not halt training — coordinate joint safety standards among frontier AI firms in democratic nations, and give embedded third-party evaluators continuous, employee-level access. Assess the implications for AI valuations, the pace of compute capex, and competitive dynamics — and how it squares with Nvidia leading Anthropic's IPO.

US August CPI came in at 3.4% y/y (in line) with core CPI at +0.3% m/m (above consensus); gasoline rose 3.9% and shelter +0.3%. Traders now price roughly a 90% chance of a hike next week and at least three hikes by mid-2027, yet spot gold is above $4,400. Goldman warns that renewed hike expectations could trigger dealer hedge unwinds and a sharper-than-usual gold correction. Explain the logic behind hikes and gold rising together, where the expectation gap sits, and the main risks.

Oracle reported fiscal Q1 revenue of $19.3bn, up 30% y/y, with cloud infrastructure revenue up 121%. The stock opened more than 7% higher but closed down 1.82%, then fell over 3% in after-hours trade to $147.67. Analyze the gap between headline growth and the share price reaction: capex and margin pressure, customer concentration in AI contracts, and what would need to change for the market to re-rate the stock.

Inspur Information plans a private placement of up to RMB9bn to build next-generation AI infrastructure and liquid-cooling compute projects, while China's State Council called for improving compute infrastructure and strengthening compute resource monitoring and dispatch. With policy and capital both stepping up, how should investors weigh profitability versus capacity risk in China's domestic compute chain?

The most-active lithium carbonate contract dropped nearly 10% below 130,000 yuan/ton, the weakest since Feb 6, before paring losses to 7.91% at 130,680, while polysilicon fell 4%. Analyze supply-demand and inventory shifts, whether the selloff already overprices oversupply, and the impact on battery and solar chain earnings expectations.

Reuters reports the Trump administration has yet to decide on refined copper tariffs, caught between securing supply and containing prices, while A-share nonferrous metals slumped with Northern Copper and Western Mining limit-down and several nonferrous ETFs off more than 4%. Analyze how much tariff expectation was embedded in record copper prices, the effect of pre-emptive US stockpiling, and asset implications if tariffs land or are dropped.

Broadcom disclosed about $179.2B in remaining performance obligations as of Aug 2, with roughly 25% expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months. Analyze what this backlog structure means for AI revenue visibility, expectations gaps, valuation, and key risks.

Apple's first foldable iPhone Duo is priced at $1,999. Goldman keeps a 14M base / 35M bull case shipment forecast for 2026, Deepwater doubled its revenue estimate, while Morningstar and Jefferies are cautious; BofA cut its target to $370 from $380. Shares closed down 0.3% at $315.34 and were up ~1.1% premarket. Analyze the real impact on ASP, margins, the supply chain, and the expectations gap.
TSMC reported August revenue of NT$514.81bn, +10.1% MoM and +53.3% YoY. Analyze what this means for AI compute supply-chain pricing, where expectations may be mispriced, and the key risks ahead.

China's MOFCOM says the two sides are negotiating a $30bn reciprocal tariff-reduction framework and aim to implement it soon; the foreign ministry says leader-level interaction this year is under discussion, and Sinograin reportedly bought ~1m tonnes of U.S. soybeans this week. Analyze which sectors and names would genuinely benefit if the framework lands, and how much is already priced in.

The NYT reports regulators are investigating Nvidia's licensing deal with Groq, even as Nvidia said it will support up to 2 gigawatts of AI infrastructure in Australia by 2027. Analyze the scope and possible outcomes of the antitrust probe, constraints on Nvidia's ecosystem deal-making, and how AI capex momentum is balanced against regulatory risk.

The Treasury tripled its long-bond buyback but bought only $6bn; the 10-year auction cleared at 4.834% and yields broke 4.84%, the highest since November 2023. Is this inflation expectations, supply pressure or fiscal credibility, and what does it mean for US equity valuations?

Europe's STOXX 600 closed down 1.57%, with the DAX -1.84%, France -2.01% and the UK -1.41%, while European gas futures topped €80/MWh for the first time since 2023. What do rising energy costs mean for European earnings and the ECB's policy path?

Dell rose over 4% to a record $559, up nearly 350% YTD, while Bloomberg reports a $4bn bond sale to refinance debt. SK Hynix's US listing hit a record, up ~5% with a $1.4trn cap, and HP launched an enterprise AI platform with Nvidia and Red Hat. Assess earnings quality and valuation risk.

Enflame lists on the STAR Market Sept 11 at 142.18 yuan, guiding Jan-Sep revenue of 2.3-3.0bn yuan, up 326%-455%, while MetaX unlocks 13.97m shares from Sept 17. Analyze valuation benchmarks, scarcity premium and unlock supply pressure.

Amazon sized its first sterling bond at £4.25bn with over £12bn of demand while the stock fell about 1.8%; Uber is also debuting in euro bonds seeking €4.5bn; separately OpenAI reportedly expects around $750bn of compute spending by 2030 and Google announced €13bn of Finnish data center investment for 2027-2028. Analyze what debt-funded AI infrastructure signals and the free cash flow risks.

DeepSeek plans to release V4.1 Flash around Sept 10, saying it beats V4 Pro on all metrics and routing V4 Pro requests at Flash pricing; its announced price cut puts cache hits at 0.02 yuan versus 1 yuan for misses, a 50x gap, while reports say DeepSeek is preparing a STAR Market IPO with CITIC doing due diligence. Analyze what collapsing inference costs mean for compute demand, cloud pricing and AI application margins.

Reuters exclusively reports a document showing India's Serious Fraud Investigation Office recommends probing Xiaomi's India unit over alleged business-model irregularities and foreign investment law compliance; Xiaomi says it has received no communication and complies with all local laws. Analyze the real impact on Xiaomi's overseas revenue, valuation discount and sentiment toward China's outbound tech names, plus what to watch next.

Google will invest at least €13bn in AI infrastructure in Finland in 2027-2028, and Fortum says the related PPA should lift group comparable RONA by about 1.4 percentage points over time. Analyze the impact on Google's free cash flow, on European power and data-center supply chains, and the risks in this AI capex cycle.

China's August CPI rose 0.8% y/y (prior 0.5%) and 0.4% m/m versus a 0.3% poll, with core CPI back at 1.0%; PPI rose 3.8% y/y versus 3.6% expected and turned to +0.4% m/m from -0.7%. The statistics bureau cited energy prices (gasoline +9.3%) and imported commodity pass-through, while food prices still fell 1.4% y/y. Analyze how much reflects real demand, and the implications for policy easing room and A-share sector allocation.

Trump signed a proclamation adjusting the scope of 50% additional tariffs on some Canadian goods effective Sept 15, while CNBC reports the White House is broadening the 50% tariff list, allowing Section 232 duties to stack, upgrading some items to outright import bans, and moving to exclude Canada from US government procurement. Analyze the pass-through to US corporate costs and inflation, the hardest-hit sectors, and whether markets are underpricing this.

The Information reports China is limiting humanoid robot IPOs after Unitree's volatile debut. On the same day, Hong Kong-listed Youdi Robotics opened its first day up more than 142%, and an industry conference said national standards for dexterous hands should be finalized and published by year-end. Analyze how tighter regulation flows through to private valuations and listed robot names, what the standards mean for the industry, and the key risks.

Meta launched its Muse AI agent, rolling out in the US on iOS, Android and muse.ai with AI glasses coming soon, plus Muse Confidential VM later this year; the same day OpenAI shipped ChatGPT Images 2.5 and two new API models. How strong is Meta's push toward a consumer AI entry point, and will the consumer AI race lift capex and squeeze margins?

Qualcomm announced a multi-generational collaboration with Amazon on custom AI data-center chips, and issued a warrant to an Amazon affiliate for up to 25M shares at $161.26, vesting in tranches up to $60B. Shares jumped over 10% pre-market and about 6% at the open. Analyze what this means for Qualcomm's valuation story, the custom AI silicon competitive landscape (implications for Broadcom and Nvidia), the dilution cost of the warrant, and what the market may be over- or under-pricing.

Apple reportedly abandoned its short-term negotiating practice and signed a three-to-five-year NAND supply agreement with Kioxia with no price cap, as AI crowds out memory capacity. Samsung's Taylor, Texas fab starts 2nm trial production late this month with capacity fully booked, and Longsys executed its first buyback for RMB448M. Analyze the durability of the memory upcycle, how pricing power shifting to suppliers hits downstream hardware costs and memory stocks including A-share and STAR Market names, and whether the market is pricing the cycle's height correctly.

ASML said TSMC and Samsung committed to using its next-generation EUV systems, and it launched an initiative with TSMC to move the industry toward High NA EUV large-field masks; ASML rose about 4% and TSMC about 2.4%. Analyze what this really means for ASML's order visibility and 2027-2028 revenue, where views diverge on High NA adoption pace, and the read-through to equipment, materials and leading-edge capex.

Verizon and Corning announced a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar deal to supply 80 million miles of high-density optical fiber through 2032 for broadband and next-gen AI infrastructure; the same day Qualcomm and Amazon said they will co-develop optical connectivity up to 1.6T, Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner, and a Chinese PCB maker announced a RMB2bn AI computing board project. Assess the evidence that AI capex is broadening from compute into optics, connectivity and power, which links benefit most, and whether orders convert to profit.

Per a Deutsche Bank note from Monday's investor briefing, BYD raised its 2026 overseas sales target to 1.9-2.0m units from 1.5m and set a goal of over 2.5m exports in 2027. Analyze the implied overseas capacity, per-unit profitability, tariff and localization risks, and the gap versus prior market expectations.

CPCA data show August narrow passenger vehicle retail sales of 1.541 million units, down 23.6% y/y, while HK-listed autos weakened (Li Auto and Leapmotor each down over 2%) and customs data show August vehicle exports of $18.33bn, up 43% y/y. Analyze the causes of the domestic demand cliff (pulled-forward subsidies, price war, high base), whether export strength can offset weak domestic demand, margin and utilization pressure across the chain, and whether EV supply-chain stocks have priced this risk.

Zimbabwe immediately banned antimony and tungsten exports and halted ore and concentrate shipments, extending the resource-localization push seen with lithium concentrate in February; the same day A-share nonferrous names surged and LME copper set a record high. Analyze the real impact on global antimony and tungsten supply and prices, which parts of the chain benefit, and how to price resource-nationalism risk.

Moutai raised the retail price of Feitian 53% 500ml at its own stores from 1,753 to 1,766 yuan, its sixth adjustment this year, with the 1L version to 3,291 yuan, while i-Moutai prices were unchanged, leaving a 127-yuan gap, staff say stock is ample, and a few small formats were cut. Analyze what this signals about channel spreads, wholesale prices and end demand, and what it means for the baijiu investment case.

The RBA's Hunter said the board may need to hike if inflation intensifies, stressing low tolerance and a desire to cool the economy and housing — yet NAB August business conditions fell to -1 from +4, confidence to -8, and Westpac consumer sentiment dropped 5.2% to 84.4. Analyze this hawkish-versus-weakening conflict and its impact on AUD and Australian assets.

China's August exports rose 25.0% y/y in USD, imports 28.2%, with a $119.09bln surplus slightly below consensus; IC exports reached $40.73bln, up 129.8% y/y, autos +43%. Analyze what really drives the chip export surge, its sustainability, and implications for STAR 50 semiconductor heavyweights.

Spot gold broke $4,440/oz (+0.77%) and COMEX gold topped $4,480; China's reserves rose to 76.73moz, a 22nd straight month of buying at the fastest pace of this cycle, even as Fed hike odds sit near 60%. Analyze the relative weight of geopolitics, central-bank demand and rate expectations in gold pricing, and the biggest correction risk.

Japan's July nominal wages rose 4.7% YoY versus 3.8% expected, the largest gain since 1997, with real wages up 2.4%, a near five-year high; Q2 real GDP was revised up to +0.4% QoQ. USD/JPY fell 0.6% to 153.41 as FinMin Katayama pledged close US coordination on orderly FX with no policy change. Assess how much of a BOJ hike is priced, and the path for the yen and Japanese equities (Nikkei futures -0.9%).

Goldman sharply raised its global optical module forecasts to roughly $67.7bn, $131.4bn and $148.5bn for 2026-2028, up 33%, 81% and 115%, citing AI server architecture shifting to high-speed networking and more modules per GPU/ASIC driving 800G, 1.6T and 3.2T demand. Innolight rose about 20% and Cambridge Technology about 24% in Hong Kong. Assess the credibility of the upgrade, where profits accrue, and the key risks.

At Xiaomi's autumn launch, Lei Jun said 21bn yuan has already been spent on in-house chips, with XRing O3 shipping and O100/D100 due in H1 next year; the Xiaomi 18 Fold starts at 10,999 yuan (ceramic edition 15,999) and the Pengcheng N70 Pro is priced at 209,900 yuan. Southbound flows bought about HK$1.38bn of Xiaomi, the largest that day. Assess how much in-house silicon and premiumization actually add to margins and valuation, and the risk from Huawei's Mate XT 2 starting at 19,999 yuan.

Final Q2 eurozone GDP was revised up to +1.2% YoY and +0.6% QoQ, both above forecasts, and September Sentix investor confidence jumped to 5.1 vs 2.0 expected; yet German July industrial production fell 1.1% MoM and 1.6% YoY, far below forecasts, the AfD took 44% in Saxony-Anhalt and Merz's approval is just 15%, reversing the German recovery trade. Analyze the conflict between the aggregate data and German fundamentals/political risk, and what it means for European equities, bunds and the euro.

Longsys priced its Hong Kong listing at HK$236 with the public offer 40.32x oversubscribed and the international tranche 3.88x, raising HK$6.80bn net, with H shares trading from Sept 8; the same day CXMT said global DRAM conditions and prices improved in H1 while it remains in a heavy capex phase and will study dividends in due course. Analyze where the memory cycle stands, the H-share versus A-share valuation gap, and debut and follow-through risks.

Tesla fell 5.92% Friday as the Cybercab update disappointed while NHTSA opened a probe into Cybercab self-certification. Analyze the optimistic robotaxi assumptions embedded in valuation, the real bite of regulatory risk, and the next catalysts to watch.

US August payrolls rose 162k vs 56k expected, with 55k of upward revisions and unemployment at 4.1%; CME odds of a September 25bp hike jumped to 60.3%. Analyze the expectation gap, why next week's CPI is decisive, and implications and risks for stocks, bonds and the dollar.

Pre-market news: Micron plans to add up to 60,000 wafers/month of HBM capacity by year-end, and Samsung is co-developing next-gen on-device AI chips with Arm. Analyze how faster HBM supply affects the memory upcycle, AI value-chain profit distribution, and the read-through to STAR 50 memory and equipment names.

Lululemon fell 18% premarket after cutting its full-year outlook, while Michael Burry said it is his largest holding, that he will keep his position and plans to add after the open, buying aggressively below $100. Analyze what the guidance cut says about the business, where market pricing and the value case diverge, and the read-across for consumer stocks.

Norway's $2.3tn sovereign fund has proposed cutting the government-debt weight in its bond benchmark from 70% to 50%, an estimated $106bn reduction in global sovereign bonds, including a 12.2-point cut in Treasury exposure worth about $80bn, while raising US non-government fixed income by 11.4 points and JGBs by 2.8 points. Separately, Chinese commercial banks are reportedly buying Treasuries after lifting dollar deposit rates. Analyze the shifting Treasury demand base and implications for long-end yields.

US average retail diesel has risen to $5.85 a gallon, topping the June 2022 record after a 17-cent jump in two days, with distillate stocks at seasonal record lows and East Coast inventories the lowest ever; Hormuz shipping is disrupted, Russia extended its diesel export ban to end-September, refiners are near capacity, and heating season demand is coming. Assess how persistent this diesel-led inflation is and what it means for Treasuries, equities and energy stocks.

Reports say September alone will bring roughly $200 billion of new US investment-grade corporate supply, on top of a $31.5 trillion Treasury market under strain with benchmark yields at their highest of Trump's second term, while AI capex is projected near $1.1 trillion next year. Analyze how AI funding needs plus fiscal borrowing could lift long-end yields and credit spreads, and what that means for richly valued tech stocks and debt-funded AI infrastructure players such as Anthropic's $15B pre-IPO facility and Crusoe's $3B raise at a $30B valuation.

Nvidia has agreed to acquire open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.93 billion. Analyze the strategic logic: moving from selling chips to controlling model distribution, what it means for the CUDA ecosystem, open-source neutrality and rivals like AMD and the clouds, whether the market has priced a software/ecosystem premium, and whether antitrust scrutiny and developer attrition are the key risks.

YMTC's Star Market IPO review status changed to the inquiry stage, against a backdrop of Samsung sharply gaining HBM share on SK Hynix, Texas Instruments' third price hike this year, and Korea scrambling to respond to US chip tariff plans. Analyze what a YMTC listing means for the STAR 50 index composition and valuations across domestic memory and semiconductor equipment/materials, plus the risks to watch.

WTI settled at $91.30 and Brent at $95.52; Saudi Arabia set October Arab Light OSPs at a $2 discount to Oman/Dubai for Asia and a $2.15 discount to Brent for NW Europe; Iraq's August exports hit 73m barrels, the highest of the Iran war; Vance said Hormuz traffic is near pre-conflict levels while US diesel averaged a record $5.820/gal. Analyze how the risk premium is priced and how it could unwind.

Snowflake beat on Q2 and raised full-year product revenue guidance, sending shares up about 24% with Oppenheimer lifting its target to $475 from $400; ServiceNow +5.5%, Salesforce +3%, Adobe +3.3% and Palantir +7.7% the same day. Analyze whether software is shifting from AI-cost pressure to AI-revenue upside, and the valuation risks.

US August ISM services PMI rose to 55.4 (consensus 54.2), new orders hit 60.9, prices paid jumped to a four-year high of 72.6, while employment stayed weak at 47.8; the 10-year yield was down 4bp at 4.754%. Analyze the implications for the Fed path and the gap versus market pricing in stocks and bonds.

Saudi-to-China VLCC earnings have climbed to about $656,000 per day, more than ten times a year ago, and Oman-to-China rose from roughly $131,000 to $220,000, sending COSCO Shipping Energy and peers limit-up — even as Europe-route container freight futures plunged 7% to 1,830. Explain the divergence between tanker and container rates, how much is Hormuz risk premium, and how much is already priced into shipping stocks.

Broadcom's FQ3 revenue was $29.59B, up 86% y/y, with FY26 AI revenue guidance lifted from $56B to $58B and management flagging a doubling to ~$115B in 2027 and $230B in 2028. Yet Q4 guidance of $34.8B missed the $35.05B consensus and gross margin is guided to ~73%. Analyze what expectations are priced in, whether the guidance blemish is overread, and the long-term logic and key risks of custom AI silicon.

A Microsoft SEC filing shows FY27 reporting will shift to two segments, Agents and Infrastructure plus Devices and Consumer, with restated Q4 Azure revenue of $29.42bn and FY27 Q1 guidance of $75.15-75.75bn for Agents & Infra and Azure growth of 44-45% in constant currency; the stock fell 0.84% Wednesday. Does the restructuring increase or reduce transparency on AI returns?

As of June 30, large holders of US assets across six markets including Japan, Canada, Australia, Denmark and Finland hedged only 41% of their dollar exposure on average, the lowest since at least 2015; every 5-point rise in hedge ratios implies roughly $230 billion of flow. The dollar index closed down 0.1% at 99.56, 10-year Treasury yields sit at 4.784% and European yields hit multi-decade highs. Analyze how a questioned safe-haven status plus falling hedging costs could become self-reinforcing selling pressure, and the knock-on effects for emerging markets and gold.

The Fed's Beige Book showed 8 of 12 districts growing slightly to modestly, flat employment and tariff costs starting to pass through to consumers, while NY Fed's Williams said inflation is slowly cooling and rates are 'well positioned' yet a hike at the next meeting isn't ruled out. Meanwhile August ADP added just 38k versus 48k expected and July factory orders rose 0.9% versus 0.6% expected. Analyze the expectations gap on the rate path and the data that matters most.

Reports say Moonshot AI (Kimi) confidentially filed an A1 with HKEX this week to start its Hong Kong IPO while raising what may be its final pre-IPO round at a roughly $50B pre-money valuation; the company declined to comment. Analyze the assumptions embedded in that valuation, the read-across for Hong Kong AI names and China's compute supply chain, and the risks to watch.
The judge in the ad tech case ruled Alphabet does not have to divest AdX but imposed behavioral remedies. What does that mean for ad revenue, the valuation discount and appeal risk?

The Baltic Dry Index rose 5.5% to 3,331, the highest since December 2023, with capesize rates up 8.1% and daily earnings at $47,666. Is this real demand or capacity and routing disruption, and what does it imply for shipping stocks and commodities?

The RBNZ unanimously raised the OCR by 25bp to 2.75%, its second straight hike, saying the move lowers the risk of larger future hikes; it lifted the Sept-2027 CPI forecast to 2.4% from 2.0% while nudging the end-2026 OCR track down to 2.81%. NZD/USD fell 0.5% to 0.5860, with banks having flagged a peak near 3.3%. Analyze the hawkish-versus-dovish read, the pricing logic behind the kiwi's drop and risks to the rate path.

South Korea's August CPI rose 3.1% y/y, below the 3.2% poll, but core CPI jumped to 3.4% from 2.6% in July, with the monthly print at 0.2% vs 0.4% expected. Analyze the implications for BOK policy, the won and semiconductor heavyweights.

Dell posted Q2 revenue of $46.97B vs $44.95B expected and adjusted EPS of $7.04 vs $4.91, raising full-year revenue guidance; shares rose over 8% after hours after closing down 6.94%. HPE gained 4% in extended trade. Analyze the core debate over AI server margins and demand durability.

NIO's Q2 revenue of RMB32.14B missed the RMB33.49B consensus while net loss narrowed sharply to RMB722M, with CEO Li Bin citing an 18.5% vehicle margin; still, the stock fell over 4% early in US trading. August deliveries diverged: Leapmotor 103k (+80.7%), Zeekr +109.8%, Xpeng just +4%. Analyze margin durability and competitive risks.

Euro area August CPI rose to 3.3% y/y from 2.9%, with core at 2.4% slightly below forecast and unemployment up to 6.4%; Italian CPI rose to 3.3%. ECB's Simkus said it is clear the bank should hike in September, and UK markets now price 50bp of BoE hikes by February. Analyze the expectations gap in European rate pricing and the impact on European equities and the euro.

Fervo signed a near-400MW Utah geothermal power deal with Google, with an option to expand to nearly 1GW by June 2030, sending Fervo up over 7% premarket, while SB Energy filed for an IPO and HUMAIN announced a new 250MW data center. Analyze how power scarcity as the AI bottleneck reprices energy and compute names, and the risks.

Samsung is allocating about 70% of its memory capacity through 2031 to long-term contract customers and targets HBM5 at twice HBM4E performance, with zHBM at eight times. GigaDevice said DRAM prices will rise moderately in H2 and tightness will not ease much in 2027, with SLC NAND strength lasting through 2027. Yet US memory names fell — Micron, Western Digital and SK Hynix all lower. Why the divergence between fundamentals and prices, and what does it mean for STAR 50 memory-chain stocks?

Hua Hong announced a $4.17bn capital injection with partners into Wuxi Hua Hong phase 3 to build a 12-inch specialty foundry line of about 55k wafers/month, pending shareholder approval; the same day GigaDevice disclosed RMB654m of buybacks for capital reduction and Luxshare RMB1bn. Analyze the specialty-capacity cycle, capex drag on returns, and implications for STAR 50 semiconductor weights.

Innolight plans to buy back 4–8 billion yuan of shares for equity incentives or an employee ownership plan, sending its A shares up over 3% and H shares up over 6% even as compute hardware and PCB names sold off. Analyze the signalling value of such a large buyback, its impact on EPS and incentive targets, and the expectation gap and risks in AI optical module demand and competition.

Shein-W (00625.HK) raised $1.7bn at HK$48.56 for about 280m shares but fell more than 10% on its Sept 1 debut, while Mech-Mind Robotics slipped below its HK$101.70 offer price and the Hang Seng fell over 1%. Analyze what these breaks say about Hong Kong IPO pricing and the long-term case for cross-border e-commerce.

Korea's August exports jumped 68.7% y/y versus a 62.6% forecast with a $34.75bn surplus, yet manufacturing PMI slipped to 52.3, the president said rate hikes are inevitable, and Seoul proposed a 2.6 trillion won 2027 chip budget. Analyze what the export boom versus tightening means for Korean equities and the chip chain.

The FTC and 22 state attorneys general allege Amazon concealed unfair charges in its digital ad auctions and reaped billions by manipulating ad pricing, while Amazon counters that the complaint cites no evidence of consumer price increases; the stock fell as much as 3.5% intraday and closed down 2.50%. Analyze advertising's profit contribution, the likely litigation path and timeline, and the valuation impact.

China Jushi has raised September electronic-fabric prices by 15% for thick and 20% for thin cloth, with mainstream averages above 10 yuan per meter, while Sinoma Science plans to raise up to 5bn yuan for high-frequency electronic fiber cloth and says second-gen LDK fabric is in shortage. Analyze the demand drivers, capacity-expansion timeline and post-2027 oversupply risk, and the earnings leverage for listed players.

Zhipu (02513.HK) reported H1 2026 revenue of RMB954m, up 399.7% year on year, as HK AI names rallied with MiniMax-W +17% and Zhipu +5% while the Hang Seng Tech index closed +0.32%. Analyze the quality of that growth, losses and cash flow, the long-term assumptions embedded in valuations, and divergence risk versus AI hardware names.

China's MOFCOM and six other ministries issued a plan to expand goods consumption, targeting around RMB60trn in retail sales by 2030, ten-trillion-yuan green, smart and health markets, easing car purchase restrictions, growing the used-car and aftermarket segments, expanding consumer loan subsidies and promoting brain-machine and AI elderly-care products. Analyze the implementation pace, real earnings leverage for autos, appliances and smart hardware, and the gap versus actual consumption data.

China's August official manufacturing PMI came in at 49.8, above the 49.6 forecast and 49.2 prior, with production and new orders at 50.4 and 50.6, while non-manufacturing held at 49.0 and the composite was 49.5. Analyze the sustainability of the demand rebound, the signal from weak services, and implications for A-share style, bonds and policy expectations.

Bank of China's A-shares rose nearly 3% and H-shares over 4%, both hitting record highs after interim net profit attributable to shareholders came in at 123.594 billion yuan, up 5.1% year on year; CITIC Bank gained over 2% with Bank of Beijing, PSBC and CCB also higher, as banks bucked a falling market and southbound net buying topped HK$3 billion. Analyze whether the record run rests on earnings and dividends or defensive rotation, and the valuation and net-interest-margin risks.

The PBOC and financial regulator issued reforms allowing mortgages of up to 40 years, following the CSRC's plan to support a new property development model. Sunac and Country Garden jumped over 14% in Hong Kong and A-share developers hit limit-up. Analyze the policy's real impact on developer cash flow and its durability.
Tianqi Lithium's H1 net profit jumped 4,925% and Gotion's Q2 profit rose 6,371% QoQ as the whole battery chain reported. Genuine cycle turn or low-base illusion?

Multiple PCB firms reported H1 results, with Jinan Guoji's net profit up 987% YoY and Huazheng New Material's Q2 profit up 359% QoQ on AI-driven demand for CCL and high-layer boards. Analyze pricing and capacity cycles, cycle durability and valuation risk.

MetaX posted H1 revenue of RMB1.324B (+44.67%) and a RMB612M net profit versus a prior loss, though part of it came from fair-value gains. Assess the real earnings quality of domestic GPU shipments and the read-across to STAR 50 heavyweights.

LONGi reported H1 revenue of RMB27.05B (-17.58%) and a RMB3.68B net loss on weaker installs, low utilization, high silver prices and FX losses. Assess how far solar capacity clearing has gone, what triggers the profit inflection, and sector timing.

State media reports liquid-cooling CDU lines are booked through late December with some firms' orders near 100% growth; China's liquid-cooled data center market hit RMB15.98B in 2025 (+45.2%) and global AI liquid cooling may top RMB100B in 2026. Analyze cold-plate versus immersion roadmaps, pricing and margin risk as capacity expands, and which STAR 50-linked names benefit first.

The UK Chancellor says windfall taxes on banks and oil companies are under consideration. Analyse the potential hit to UK bank and oil-and-gas earnings, dividends and buybacks, how markets are pricing the odds of enactment, and the transmission to UK equities and European energy and financial ETFs.

EIA data show U.S. gas output rising to 122.6 bcf/d in August (from 122 in July) and oil output near 13.83 million bpd, easing to 13.77 million bpd in September, while gas whipsaws around $2.89 with over 1% daily swings. Analyze the tension between supply growth and demand (LNG exports, power/AI data-center load) and the likely price path.

Anthropic is preparing to let existing shareholders sell some shares in its IPO while considering a longer-than-usual lockup; its private valuation hit $965bn in May and bankers have discussed an IPO valuation of about $1.5 trillion. Separately, music publishers have sued the company over copyrighted works. Analyze what insider selling means for pricing and float, the revenue assumptions implied by a $1.5tn valuation, and the risks from copyright litigation and AI capex funding pressure.

Trump says the US has secured majority control of over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan proven reserves, while Chevron is close to completing negotiations on migrating its joint ventures. Yet WTI settled at $83.40 (-0.16%) and Brent at $89.31 (-0.43%). Analyze the realistic production timeline, the impact on the medium-term supply curve, and why the market shrugged.

OpenAI says it is ending its partnership with Cursor after the company's acquisition by SpaceX. Analyze the shift from cooperation to competition between AI coding tools and foundation-model providers, Musk's strategic intent in consolidating AI applications, and the long-term investment logic and risks for related software and compute names.

Reports say the Advent-Stripe consortium will walk away from acquiring PayPal; the stock fell over 18% premarket and opened down nearly 14%, its worst since Feb 3, while Affirm jumped 16% on a strong revenue outlook. Analyze payments-sector pricing once the deal premium disappears.

Marvell's FY26 Q2 revenue of $2.74bn and 94-cent EPS both beat, but its long-term revenue outlook was not raised meaningfully and the stock opened down 7-8%. Analyze how high expectations for custom AI ASICs have been set and what the next checkpoints are.

CXMT posted H1 revenue of 150.3bn yuan (+873% y/y) and net profit of 77.6bn yuan, swinging to profit, and says the global DRAM shortage will persist in H2 with LPDDR6 sampling to key customers. Analyze where we are in the memory cycle and the impact on the STAR 50 and domestic memory chain valuations.

Meituan posted Q2 revenue of RMB104.64bn vs RMB101.08bn expected and operating profit of RMB2.69bn versus an expected loss, with core local commerce revenue up 10.1% to RMB71.5bn and segment operating profit back to RMB5.7bn, yet H1 adjusted net loss was RMB2.44bn. How sustainable is the margin recovery, and what is the risk of renewed subsidy wars?

SK Hynix's CEO expects the memory shortage to continue through end-2030 with no meaningful downturn signals, while launching a $4B Indiana memory hub with HBM4E volume production in H2 2029 and talking to 100+ materials/equipment partners for a local supply chain. Yet memory stocks were mixed (SK Hynix +2%, Western Digital -1.47%, SanDisk -0.96%, Micron -2.6% intraday). Analyze the gap between industry guidance and share reaction, pricing implications and risks.

NVIDIA posted FY27Q2 revenue of $96.2B (+106% y/y) and guided FY28 revenue growth to about 70% versus the ~45% consensus; shares opened up ~7%, adding $359B in market cap. Break down where the expectation gap comes from, how credible it is, and the key risks.

China Life reported H1 revenue of RMB434.3bn (+81.5%) and net profit of RMB134.5bn (+228.6%) with a RMB0.358 dividend, while CPIC's profit rose 10.4% to RMB30.8bn with a RMB0.42 dividend. Analyze how much comes from investment gains versus underwriting, its sustainability, and what it means for insurer valuations.

Mixue's H1 revenue rose just 2.3% to RMB15.22B while net profit fell about 15% to RMB2.3B, and it proposed a special dividend of RMB2.65 per share, yet the Hong Kong shares fell as much as 10% in the afternoon as the Hang Seng closed down 0.34%. What growth was priced in, why did store and coffee expansion not translate into profit, and can a big payout rebuild the valuation?
